methodology_note: S1 starts at the same Ethereum block as S3. This candidate map deliberately reuses the reviewed native contract families and source-derived symbolic analyses frozen for S3, including the marketplace/router extensions. It is not accepted by inheritance: the S1 pipeline recomputes conservative source conflict/storage coverage over all 5,000 public-RPC blocks and reports the highest-impact unmapped owners before native execution. Those public-RPC accesses are an offline family-coverage diagnostic only; no S1 historical concrete storage keys are embedded in the call plan or exposed to Rust-ACG prediction. Exact access/oracle claims remain restricted to S3 unless exact S1 SLOAD/SSTORE traces are collected separately.

translation_rules: Every source Ethereum transaction remains in the same block and transaction position.
Every distinct Ethereum storage-owner address maps to a distinct native instance namespace even when code families are shared.
Mapped CALL/STATICCALL frames become native contract actions; DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE frames inherit the parent storage namespace and are represented as inlined implementation/helper actions.
Unsupported or unselected calls become explicit background-fallback actions and are never deleted.
Concrete historical reads/writes are used only for offline coverage accounting and must never be embedded in the native execution plan or exposed to SymbGraph prediction.
Native conflict-topology fidelity is not claimed until concrete accesses from translated native execution are measured against the source trace.

Version-2 exact-ground-truth family extensions may use owner-level attribution to select a pre-declared semantic family, but may not consume historical concrete EVM storage keys, values, or per-transaction access sets during planning/execution.
